instruments.notes: Costless collar entered July 1999; reference price Panhandle Eastern Pipeline Company, Texas, Oklahoma Mainline Index. Filing says open hedges at 12/31/1999 would have produced a gain of approx $500,000 in aggregate (not attributed to a single instrument).
instruments.evidence_quote:
In July 1999, Gothic entered into a costless collar agreement with respect
to the production of 50,000 mmbtu per day during the period of November 1999
through March 2000, which placed a floor of $2.30 per mmbtu and a ceiling of
$3.03 per mmbtu.

instruments.notes: Stated as 10,000 barrels per month (not daily); described only as a 'hedge agreement' at a fixed price; instrument type assumed swap-like fixed-price hedge. Entered August 1999.
instruments.evidence_quote:
August 1999, Gothic entered into a hedge agreement covering 10,000 barrels of
oil per month at a price of $20.10 per barrel. This hedge was in effect from
September 1999 through August 2000.

instruments.notes: Entered January 2000; described as hedge agreement at a fixed price; index Panhandle Eastern Pipeline Company, Texas, Oklahoma Mainline Index.
instruments.evidence_quote:
Additionally, in January 2000, Gothic entered into a hedge agreement
covering 50,000 mmbtu per day at a fixed price of $2.435 per mmbtu. This hedge
was in effect from April 2000 through October 2000.

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: Objective is to hedge a portion of exposure to price volatility from producing natural gas; not for trading. Uses swaps, purchased puts, sold calls. No open hedges at December 31, 2000.
